name: What safety precautions should I take during heavy bag training to avoid injury?
description: Always use hand wraps and gloves, warm up, focus on correct technique, and listen to your body to prevent injuries during heavy bag training.

mainEntity.name: What safety precautions should I take during heavy bag training to avoid injury?

acceptedAnswer.text: To avoid injury during heavy bag training, always use proper hand wraps and well-fitting boxing gloves to protect your hands and wrists. Start with a thorough warm-up to prepare your muscles and joints. Focus on correct technique, such as rotating your hips and pivoting your feet, rather than solely relying on arm strength. Listen to your body and don't overexert yourself, especially when starting out. If you feel pain, stop and assess. Our coaches at Cave Training emphasize form to minimize injury risk and maximize results.
